A '''communicator factory''' was located in [[Arginall City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. It supplied spare parts and technical equipment to the local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Arginall Garrison|garrison]].
